_: WHAT HAPPENS IF THE PLAN IS WRONG — one assumption at a time, then in
Every case re-runs the whole model. None is a multiplier on a finished
total, because a shock changes what the College can teach, which
changes what it admits, which changes the establishment it needs.

enrolmentLower.name: Enrolment twenty per cent lower
enrolmentLower.s: Every market converts a fifth fewer enquiries into enrolments
enrolmentLower.warning: Enrolments against plan, two consecutive intakes

continuationLower.name: Continuation ten points lower
continuationLower.s: Ten percentage points fewer learners continue from each level to the next
continuationLower.warning: Continuation at any level five points below plan for two terms

acquisitionDearer.name: Acquisition a quarter dearer
acquisitionDearer.s: Every enquiry costs a quarter more to generate
acquisitionDearer.warning: Cost per enrolment above plan for two consecutive terms

benchmarkAverages.name: Acquisition at the benchmark averages
benchmarkAverages.s: Enquiries cost the benchmark average of $140 rather than the median of $106, and convert at the 4.9% the averages imply rather than 9.0%
benchmarkAverages.warning: Cost per enrolment above $2,000 in any market for two terms

payHigher.name: Academic pay fifteen per cent higher
payHigher.s: The national market for qualified teachers of English tightens
payHigher.warning: Vacancies open more than one term

executiveThinner.name: Executive demand half the plan
executiveThinner.s: Half of the executive and bespoke learners the plan expects take the Tutored route instead
executiveThinner.warning: Executive share of Gulf enrolments below plan for two intakes

agreementsLate.name: Institutional agreements a year late
agreementsLate.s: Both agreement channels open a year later and ramp a year behind
agreementsLate.warning: No signed agreement by the planned opening term

gulfLate.name: Gulf launch two terms late
gulfLate.s: The first market opens two terms behind plan
gulfLate.warning: Admissions not open by the planned term

technologyDearer.name: Technology fifty per cent dearer
technologyDearer.s: Every purchased technology line costs half as much again
technologyDearer.warning: Platform spend above budget for two quarters

sterlingStronger.name: The pound ten per cent stronger
sterlingStronger.s: The College earns in dollars and pays in pounds; every sterling cost is ten per cent dearer in dollars for the whole decade
sterlingStronger.warning: The dollar below its planning rate against sterling for a full term

priceSensitive.name: Demand sensitive to price
priceSensitive.s: Enrolment falls by eight tenths of one per cent for each one per cent the tariff stands above the plan's reference
priceSensitive.warning: Offer acceptance below plan in the premium routes

capitalLate.name: Second tranche of capital two terms late
capitalLate.s: The capital needed to expand arrives two terms after the gate it was released against
capitalLate.warning: Tranche not drawn by the gate date

slowStart.name: A slow start
slowStart.s: The first market opens late, converts less well and costs more to reach — the case the founding capital must survive

thinPremium.name: A thinner premium market
thinPremium.s: The top of the market is smaller and more price-conscious than planned

institutionalDelay.name: Partners slower than planned
institutionalDelay.s: The institutional channels arrive late and learners persist less
